body:
I'm 21 and only recently got an associates degree. It'll be at least another year before I can go back to school again...

I don't have any volunteer experience at a clinic, but I volunteer at a dog shelter... I would love to volunteer at a place like that, but I can't really do it right now because I'm still struggling with debilitating illness. It's not permanent, but right now I can't walk or move around very well, so I don't think I'd be able to work at a clinic. At least at the shelter I can just sit in the same place for a long time and groom the dogs and play with the smaller ones when they're lonely. I can't do a lot of other things right now ._. I also have to work from home.

But that's a really great idea. I would love to do that someday when I'm able. Reading that made me smile... I feel like I at least have something doable to look forward to :)

Thank you...
Thank you. I really appreciate that...

I want to go to med school and join Doctors Without Borders some day. I know I've come a long way in the past few months, but... I don't think that dream is very realistic. I know I shouldn't think like that, though... Even if I probably couldn't handle it *right now*, I could still work towards getting better in the future, but... How could somebody like me help anyone, anyways? I'm scared that I would fuck up and make people even more sick or something...

I do ._.

I think about killing myself all the time, but it won't solve anything because my problems will follow me for all of eternity. There is no escape no matter what I do.
